world_news_real.title: Drowning deaths soar in France as Europe buckles in peak of heatwave
world_news_real.description: Forty people have drowned in heatwave-related deaths in France since last Thursday, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu says.

world_news_real.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back
world_news_real.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

world_news_real.title: UN commission of inquiry says Israel committing genocide in Gaza by deliberately targeting children
world_news_real.description: Israel rejects the new report by the three-member expert panel, calling it a "libellous sham".

world_news_real.title: Zambia ex-president's family wins latest legal battle over what should happen to his body
world_news_real.description: Edgar Lungu's family and the Zambian government remain in dispute 12 months after he died.

world_news_real.title: Trump anticipates better relationship with Colombia under new leader
world_news_real.description: Abelardo de la Espriella, who preliminary results suggest is Colombia's next president, had Trump's endorsement.

world_news_real.title: Spider which uses spring trap to capture prey discovered in Australia
world_news_real.description: Researchers say their hunting method - which allows them to prey on dangerous ants - is unprecedented.

world_news_real.title: Irish government to contribute £197m to cross-border rail services
world_news_real.description: The money will come from the last allocation from the Irish government's Shared Island Fund.

world_news_real.title: Montreal shooting leaves officer, civilian and suspect dead
world_news_real.description: It was the first time in 24 years that a Montreal police officer was  killed in the line of duty, the city's police chief said.

world_news_real.title: Ransom note claims Nancy Guthrie died after abduction
world_news_real.description: The note from the possible kidnappers reportedly stated that they did not mean for her to die and included an apology to the family.

world_news_real.title: Dettol apologises after ad to clean up 'toxic men' backfires in China
world_news_real.description: The ad sparked accusations of sexism in China, after featuring a man looking for a partner who is "not tainted by other men".
